subcodes.first_line: Glorified be He Who hath sent down the verses and revealed the clear proofs, and caused all things to proclaim that verily there is no God but Him, the True One, the Knower of things unseen. By Thy might [3.5s]
subcodes.first_line_orig: سبحان الذی انزل الایات و اظهر البینات و انطق الاشیاء علی انه لا اله الا هو الحق علام الغیوب و عزتک
